note: Prespecified sensitivity analyses of the episode-pattern contrast in the pooled MOVER + VitalDB waveform cohort. Rows were read from SENSITIVITY_S1_SOURCE_V4_1.json, the archived sensitivity model report of the locked v1.0 analysis; the source file is included in this directory and its SHA-256 is recorded below. Values are kept at full precision and formatted in the table.
flame_note: The prespecified flexible accumulation model (FLAME) retained one effective degree of freedom at basis dimensions 5 and 6 (chi-square 1.99, P=0.158) and therefore collapsed towards a linear duration effect, which makes the scenario contrast null by construction. A two-hinge specification produced hinges with opposing coefficients that were not separately identifiable. All sensitivity models converged without separation.
